annotations.title: Paid Social Ad Campaigns & Post Boosting

description: Create, list, pause, resume, inspect metrics, or boost organic posts into paid social ad campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, X Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads, and TikTok Spark Ads with 0% Nuntior ad-spend commission. Use this tool when an organic post performs strongly and should be amplified to a targeted B2B or consumer audience with a controlled daily budget. Returns campaign configuration, status, targeting parameters, and real-time spend/conversion snapshots.

action.description: Paid ads operation: 'list' campaigns, 'create' a new campaign, 'boost_post' to turn an existing organic post into a paid ad, 'pause' or 'resume' delivery, or fetch 'metrics'.

campaignId.description: Ad campaign identifier (`camp_...`). Required when pausing, resuming, or querying a specific campaign.

dailyBudgetUsd.description: Daily ad spend cap in USD (e.g. 25 for $25/day). Nuntior charges 0% markup on ad spend.

name.description: Human-readable campaign name (e.g. 'Q4 AI Agent Launch — LinkedIn Sponsored Update').

objective.description: Campaign optimization objective: 'leads' (lead gen forms/signups), 'traffic' (website clicks), 'engagement' (likes/replies), or 'awareness' (reach/impressions).

postIdToBoost.description: Existing Nuntior organic post ID (`post_...`) to promote when `action` is 'boost_post'.

profileId.description: Brand profile identifier (`prof_...`) linked to the ad account.

targeting.description: Structured audience targeting criteria such as countries, job titles, industries, or interest keywords (e.g. `{ "countries": ["US", "AE", "ES"], "titles": ["CTO", "Founder"] }`).
